title: Hamilton-connected cores and five cycle--wheel Ramsey numbers
summary: Let $W_s=K_1+C_{s-1}$ denote the wheel on $s$ vertices. We give structural proofs that $R(C_{14},W_{11})=27$ and $R(C_{15},W_{11})=29$. Together with the theorem of Chen et al. for $n\ge16$, these equalities give $R(C_n,W_{11})=2n-1$ for every $n\ge14$. The two boundary values were included in an earlier survey announcement. We also give structural proofs of $R(C_8,W_7)=15$, $R(C_9,W_7)=17$, and $R(C_8,W_9)=15$. The common starting point is a Hamilton-connected core lemma.
